credits.intro_explanation: The values presented are the years in which various developmental milestones in languages occurred.

items.title: Ape Noises And Gestures
items.description: Our chimp ancestors spoke with hoots and gestures

items.title: Language Section Of Brain Develops
items.description: The FOXP2 gene gave us the language part of our brain

items.title: Voice Box Evolves Fully
items.description: A lower larynx unlocked many more distinct sounds

items.title: Clicking Languages
items.description: Some languages like Khoisan still use clicking sounds

items.title: Trade Language
items.description: Clay tokens counted goods: writing grew from accounting

items.title: First Written Symbols
items.description: Chinese Jiahu might be a primitive form of writing

items.title: AI Masters Language
items.description: ChatGPT writes fluently: a huge shift like printing

items.title: One Global Language
items.description: Humanity may converge on a single shared tongue
